name: Manissa
text: Manissa is the anglicization of Maigneis, the second wife of Fionn mac Cumhaill. Readers who meet the English form in translated sources should follow the main entry under Maigneis for the family ties and the tale role.

attributes.attribute: is the second wife of Fionn mac Cumhaill

okr.objective: Records Manissa as the anglicized form of Maigneis.
